memory_update.text: HMDPF / TSX:HPS.A should be tracked as the closest pure-play-style underfollowed candidate for dry-type transformers and power-quality products, despite OTC/Canada listing complexity.
POWL is not a dry-type transformer specialist but belongs in the adjacent power-control/switchgear bottleneck set because of large backlog and explicit mega data-center order evidence.
HUBB's Acme Electric PDU transformer and power-quality catalog exposure makes Hubbell a useful larger-cap comparator for dry-type transformer and data-center electrical distribution exposure.

Need a later Layer 2 pass to separate true transformer capacity constraints from broader electrical-equipment demand, using lead times, backlog mix, manufacturing footprint, channel inventory, and customer concentration.

node: Dry-type transformers and power-quality electrical equipment
summary: Expanded universe for the dry-type transformer and power-quality node using a two-lane funnel. Reference lane is anchored by broad electrical leaders with explicit transformer, switchgear, data-center, utility, and backlog evidence. Underfollowed lane emphasizes purer or narrower suppliers where power-conditioning equipment, dry-type transformers, engineered electrical distribution, or data-center electrical systems can become schedule-critical bottlenecks. No buy/sell view is implied.
